name: Bukit Jalil Half Marathon & 10km Friendship Run by LGRA 2026
short_description: Bukit Jalil Half Marathon & 10km Friendship Run by LGRA 2026 is on Sunday 6 December 2026 at Bukit Jalil Recreation Park in Kuala Lumpur, over 0.7 km, 3.5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km.
ai_summary: The Bukit Jalil Half Marathon & 10km Friendship Run by LGRA 2026 is a community event at Bukit Jalil Recreation Park (Pintu C), Kuala Lumpur, on 6 December 2026, running from 4:00 am to 11:00 am. Categories are a 21 km long run challenge, a 10 km speed run challenge, a 3.5 km walk and kids fun run, and a 700 m kids dash. The page does not publish a route map, so whether the 21 km stays inside the park is not stated.

faqs.question: What time is the Bukit Jalil Half Marathon & 10km Friendship Run by LGRA 2026?
faqs.answer: The event runs from 4:00 am to 11:00 am on Sunday 6 December 2026 at Bukit Jalil Recreation Park. Separate flag-off times per category are not listed on the event page.

faqs.question: How much is the 21 km?
faqs.answer: The 21 km long run challenge costs RM109 at the early bird rate and RM119 at the normal rate. The top 15 finishers receive an additional tee.
